constraints.name: CK_WeeklyOpeningDays_Interval
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("Closed" AND ("OpensAtMinute" IS NULL) AND ("ClosesAtMinute" IS NULL)) OR ((NOT "Closed") AND ("OpensAtMinute" IS NOT NULL) AND ("ClosesAtMinute" IS NOT NULL) AND ("OpensAtMinute" >= 0) AND ("OpensAtMinute" < "ClosesAtMinute") AND ("ClosesAtMinute" <= 1440))))
